proposed.text: A member has computed bending stress fb = 14 MPa while the supplied allowable bending stress is Fb = 12 MPa. What source-safe design action is required?

options.text: The bending check fails; resize the member, reduce the demand, or use a source-supported higher allowable value.
The member passes because the computed value is close to the allowable value.
Use Fb/fb = 0.86 as an uncited strength increase factor.
Ignore the check if shear is acceptable.

rationale.correct: The ASD inequality is not satisfied because 14 MPa > 12 MPa. The member needs redesign or a source-supported allowable value.
rationale.takeaway: An ASD check fails whenever demand stress exceeds allowable stress.
